title: Role panels (School DB)
brief: One panel per role for the signed-in app: the teacher keeps the student administration, the admin gains accounts (create, reset password) and branding (logo + seed color with the palette re-deriving), and the student keeps their own record. Every artboard shows the three role experiences; the directions differ in how the admin reaches the three areas.

artboards.title: Top tabs
artboards.tradeoff: Smallest change to the shipped pages (the top bar grows a tab row); tabs crowd on very narrow screens, and the student view is tab-less by design.

artboards.title: Side rail
artboards.tradeoff: Material You rail scales to more areas and reads clearly on wide screens; it costs horizontal space from the table and is the biggest departure from the shipped layout.

artboards.title: Role hub
artboards.tradeoff: A calm per-role home that hides nothing and explains each area; adds one navigation hop before any real work, and the hub itself holds no data.
